RootLayout.title: AFTECH AI Platform
RootLayout.description: AFTECH AI portal — document assistant, library, dashboard.

Topbar.demoProfileTooltip: Demo profile — no real authentication is active.

Common.backendUnavailableDefault: The backend is not responding right now (no GPU available, or the service is stopped).
Common.explicationComplete: All statements in the answer were verified against the documents.
Common.explicationPartial: Only part of the statements could be verified — some information may be missing.
Common.explicationNotFound: No verifiable statement was found in the indexed documents.

Errors.authDescription: The backend rejected the API key. Check BACKEND_API_KEY on the Next.js server side (frontend/.env.local).
Errors.validationDefault: The question format was not accepted.
Errors.unavailableDefault: The backend is not responding (no GPU available, or the service is stopped).
Errors.timeoutDescription: The AI engine did not start in time. A first call after inactivity can take several minutes — please try again shortly.
Errors.questionTooLong: The question is too long (maximum {max} characters).
Errors.serverMisconfigured: The Next.js server is not configured correctly (missing backend key).

Assistant.topbarDescription: Ask a question about the indexed documents.
Assistant.examplesIntro: Ask a question about the indexed documents. Examples:
Assistant.exampleQuestion1: What is the main objective of the AI Platform & Model Infrastructure Epic?
Assistant.exampleQuestion2: Which primary LLM runtime is recommended?
Assistant.exampleQuestion3: Which document contains information about Azure?
Assistant.placeholder: Ask your question… (Enter to send, Shift+Enter for a new line)
Assistant.coldStartMessage: The AI engine is starting up. The first call can take a few minutes.
Assistant.backendSeemsUnavailable: The backend appears unavailable — check that it is running (see Administration).

Bibliotheque.topbarDescription: Documents actually indexed by the backend.
Bibliotheque.dropzoneLabel: Drop a PDF here, or click to choose one
Bibliotheque.emptyNoDocumentsDescription: The index does not currently contain any documents.

Dashboard.topbarDescription: Only metrics that are actually measured.
Dashboard.gpuCheckExplanation: Runs a real check of the GPU engine (Qwen + BGE-M3). Never automatic: each click can wake the Modal container.
Dashboard.gpuCheckUnavailable: The GPU engine did not respond (no GPU available, or the service is stopped).
Dashboard.statusBreakdownEmpty: No request measured since startup — the chart will appear after the first questions.
Dashboard.statusBreakdownAriaLabel: Breakdown of response statuses since startup
Dashboard.benchmarkNotExecutedDescription: Run ./scripts/run_gpu_benchmark.sh <T4|L4|A100> then scripts/build_gpu_comparison.py to fill this section.
Dashboard.benchmarkRecommendationNote: Detailed recommendation by use case: see results/benchmarks/gpu/recommendation.md

Administration.demoModeDescription: All data in this area (users, roles, audit log) is fictitious. No real multi-organization authentication is active, and none of the actions below have any real effect.
Administration.roleAiManagerDesc: Configures allowed models and access policies.
Administration.roleUserDesc: Uses the AI Assistant and browses the Library.
Administration.roleAuditorDesc: Read-only access to the audit log and metrics.
Administration.policiesDescription: No real access policy is enforced yet. This area is prepared for future enterprise authentication (see docs/KNOWN_LIMITATIONS.md).
Administration.auditQuestion: Question asked to the AI Assistant

Integrations.topbarDescription: No connector is active yet in this version.
Integrations.jiraNote: First real integration planned after Demo V1.
Integrations.noSecretNote: No secret is stored here. Real configuration is not yet available for this integration.
